doc.description:
Extened Kalman filter based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extended_Kalman_filter
Designed to merge only IMU and OptiTrack/VICON (no baro, sonar, GPS, ...)
- predict attitude and path with gyroscopes and accelerometers - correct attitude and path with external pose and position message - estimate gyro and accelerometer biases - drop delayed poses using the capture time in the EXTERNAL_POSE timestamp field (ms) - drop poses whose attitude innovation is too large (reset after repeated rejections)
Bypassed when simulating.

define.name: INS_EXT_POSE_MAX_AGE
define.description: maximum pose age above the lowest receive delay [ms], 0 to disable

define.name: INS_EXT_POSE_GATE_RESET_NB
define.description: consecutive gated poses before resetting the filter on the pose

define.name: INS_EXT_POSE_TIMEOUT
define.description: time without fused pose before the filter status is reported lost [s]
